name: Distill Purity
description: Separates toxins, impurities, spoilage, and magical contamination from liquids and simple compounds.

name: Emberglass Phial
description: Produces a small volatile reaction for flame, flash, smoke, heat, or ignition.

name: Quick Salve
description: Creates a field-ready paste that numbs pain, seals light wounds, and stabilizes a subject long enough for better treatment.

name: Solvent Drop
description: Dissolves glue, rust, grime, resin, or simple bindings without ruining the core material.

name: Assayer's Eye
description: Identifies broad properties in a substance: poisonous, curative, catalytic, volatile, spoiled, unstable, or inert.

name: Flashpowder
description: Throws or ignites a compound that bursts in glare, smoke, heat, or concussive sting.

name: Stoneblood Elixir
description: Temporarily hardens skin, blood, or bone against injury and fatigue at the cost of stiffness or slowdown.

name: Vapor Veil
description: Boils a mixture into concealing mist, sedative fume, irritant cloud, or suggestive haze depending on ingredients.

name: Quickbrew Elixir
description: Rapidly compounds a simple antidote, stimulant, restorative, coagulant, or utility draught from prepared materials.

name: Transmuter's Edge
description: Temporarily alters the material quality of an object or surface — brittle to supple, dull to keen, dense to porous, reactive to inert.

name: Homunculus Seed
description: Brews and shapes a small obedient alchemical servitor for scouting, carrying, tending apparatus, or delivering substances.

name: Philosopher's Suspension
description: Places a body, specimen, reagent, or volatile mixture into near-perfect suspended stability against decay, separation, or immediate failure.

name: Plagueveil Crucible
description: Floods an area with engineered alchemical atmosphere that may heal, sedate, blind, sterilize, corrode, or poison depending on design.

name: Transmutation Crucible
description: Rewrites the physical properties of a significant mass of matter — stone to ceramic, metal to brittle salt, timber to mineral fiber, and similar controlled shifts.

name: Magnum Opus
description: The supreme alchemical working: a mythic transformation of body, matter, or condition capable of creating panacea, perfection, monstrosity, or profound purification according to intent and method.
